name: aws_msk_cluster
description: Creates an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (MSK) cluster for building real-time streaming data pipelines and applications.

kafka_version.name: kafka_version
kafka_version.description: Specify the desired Kafka software version. E.g., 3.5.1.

number_of_broker_nodes.name: number_of_broker_nodes
number_of_broker_nodes.description: The desired total number of broker nodes in the kafka cluster. Must be a multiple of the number of Availability Zones.

enhanced_monitoring.name: enhanced_monitoring
enhanced_monitoring.description: Specify the desired enhanced MSK CloudWatch monitoring level.
